# Templates

Use these templates to keep agent and human work consistent.

- [Issue](issue.md)
- [Feature brief](feature-brief.md)
- [Implementation plan](implementation-plan.md)
- [Architecture decision](architecture-decision.md)
- [Run brief](run-brief.md)
- [Question](question.md)
- [Approval request](approval-request.md)
- [Agent handoff](agent-handoff.md)
- [Review bundle](review-bundle.md)
- [Incident postmortem](incident-postmortem.md)
- [Release checklist](release-checklist.md)
- [Research report](research-report.md)

Templates are starting points. Remove instructional text before finalizing an artifact, but do not omit applicable sections merely for brevity.
